pairs: et Timotheus ecclesiæ Thessalonicensium in Deo Patre, et Domino Jesu Christo.
to the church of the Thessalonians, in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Gratias agimus Deo semper pro omnibus vobis,
We give thanks to God always for all of you,
memoriam vestri facientes in orationibus nostris sine intermissione,
keeping the memory of you in our prayers without ceasing,
et sustinentiæ spei Domini nostri Jesu Christi,
quia Evangelium nostrum non fuit ad vos in sermone tantum,
For our Gospel has not been among you in word alone,
sicut scitis quales fuerimus in vobis propter vos.
in the same manner as you know we have acted among you for your sake.
Et vos imitatores nostri facti estis,
you became imitators of us and of the Lord,
accepting the Word in the midst of great tribulation,
but with the joy of the Holy Spirit.
ita ut facti sitis forma omnibus credentibus in Macedonia,
So have you become a pattern for all who believe in Macedonia
A vobis enim diffamatus est sermo Domini,
the Word of the Lord was spread,
not only in Macedonia and in Achaia,
et in omni loco fides vestra,
profecta est ita ut non sit nobis necesse quidquam loqui.
has advanced so much so that we do not need to speak to you about anything.
Ipsi enim de nobis annuntiant qualem introitum habuerimus ad vos:
For others are reporting among us of the kind of acceptance we had among you,
et quomodo conversi estis ad Deum a simulacris,
and how you were converted from idols to God,
to the service of the living
et exspectare Filium ejus de cælis (quem suscitavit a mortuis) Jesum,
and to the expectation of his Son from heaven (whom he raised up from the dead), Jesus,
qui eripuit nos ab ira ventura.
who has rescued us from the approaching wrath.
